review: Communications approval, queue and governance concurrency closure

correctedFindings.finding: Outbox insertion and draft queue transition could separate on interruption or stale state

correctedFindings.finding: Concurrent instruction-profile approvals could overwrite review authority or leave multiple active profiles

correctedFindings.finding: Template approval returned success after a stale concurrent write
correctedFindings.resolution: Approval is compare-and-set and only audits a successful state transition

correctedFindings.finding: Template and instruction versions used read-then-write numbering
